items.statement: Validated optimization and stationary-point evidence is reported for each state.
items.expected: Each state has convergence and zero imaginary frequencies, or explicit bounded failure.

items.statement: Named distances are extracted with preserved atom identity.
items.expected: Four named distances are reported separately for both states with mapping.

items.statement: Computed state changes are compared with the experimental structural boundary.
items.expected: The directions and spatial localization of the computed structural changes are interpreted.
